plan.title: feat(harness,build): ban re-init/session ceremony after offline seed

narratives.Description: feat(harness,build): ban re-init/session ceremony after offline seed
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

DevHammer multi-scope trials burned agent turns on `directive init`, full cold `session:start`, migrate, and re-copy scopes **after** offline init/seed already ran ritual + pin seed. Each re-invoke still costs a **turn** (and re-reads the prefix) even when v0.90 made ceremony **faster** (#2991–#2993).

## Goal

When seed + session ritual are already complete for the engagement, agents **must not** re-run install-phase ceremony.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Multi-scope / build / app-bank style preambles (or documented consumer contract) state absolutely: session ritual and pin seed are done — do **not** run `directive init`, full cold `session:start` (unless hooks require recovery via `session:ready` / re-arm), `directive migrate`, or re-copy scopes
- [ ] Recovery path remains: `session:ready` or re-arm when PreToolUse denies — not full re-init
- [ ] Docs distinguish offline seed phase vs agent implement phase
- [ ] CHANGELOG if user-facing

## Non-goals

- Widening `DEFT_SESSION_RITUAL_SKIP` for interactive product sessions without policy
- Removing hooks or gated ritual at true mutation boundaries

## Parent

Part of multi-scope turn/cache budget epic (post-v0.90 ceremony).

## Source

DevHammer trajectory: ceremony re-entry after offline init.
